capabilities: Create forms with 17 field types in a settings-based form browser
Fill forms in a modal to create notes, insert text, or edit the current note's properties
Build note names, folders, and templates from answers using placeholders and transformations
Validate answers with required flags, bounds, regex checks, and show conditions
Run forms from commands, buttons, or a JavaScript openForm API, with import/export as JSON
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or newer. List-from-Dataview-query fields execute user JavaScript and are disabled by default. Forms live in plugin settings, not vault files; moving vaults needs the built-in JSON export. Dragging does not work on mobile. The catalogue listing has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Creating the same kind of note repeatedly means retyping the same headings and properties by hand, and templates cannot prompt you for the values each time.

relations.evidence: The List from a Dataview query field takes its options from the result of a query.
Templater will then run the <% … %> commands in the form template
any plugin that can run commands will pick it up: Buttons, Meta Bind, Commander

summary: Form builder that opens a modal of fields and turns the answers into a new note, edited properties, or text inserted at the cursor.
